[RTCT.5.6] **`contract:` population.** The emitted
`.profile` MUST contain a `contract:` section whose values
are the observed peaks verbatim (per-field correspondences
in [RTCT.3.2]). This makes `cp foo.profile foo.dsrt` a
valid starting point — the resulting `.dsrt` is a valid
contract that exactly fits the observed workload (no
headroom). The author edits up from there.
